question: When solving \(2x-3=5x+6\), which equation correctly results from transposing terms?
solution: A term changes sign when transposed: moving \(5x\) to the left changes it to \(-5x\), and moving \(-3\) to the right changes it to \(+3\), giving \(2x-5x=6+3\).

reference.question: When solving \(2x-3=5x+6\), which equation correctly results from transposing terms?

A term changes sign when transposed: moving \(5x\) to the left changes it to \(-5x\), and moving \(-3\) to the right changes it to \(+3\), giving \(2x-5x=6+3\).
